assumptions: All attacks are deterministic. Passive PRD, items, fireball and damage-over-time are disabled.
Living order controls range: warrior 1, mage 2. Warrior is the front ally.

Mechanics attempt winding every even numbered phase enemy turn while charges remain. Only positive healing on a living shell spends a charge; full or dead shell leaves the attempt idle with charges preserved.
After heal charges are exhausted, mechanics use their low attack on subsequent phases.
Death leaves visual slots fixed. Attack range still counts living order. Enemy resolution retains original slot order: mechanic A, mechanic B, shell; then soldier, core.
All legal attack lines and death-completion lines are assumed drawable. No board/path verification is represented.
A completed action produces one enemy phase even when all enemies have died; no living actors attack.
Cooldown decreases after every later completed team round, including the phase-ending round; cast round does not decrease.
Mandatory free lines are assumed completed before transition. Neither free lines nor flip advances cooldown or enemies.
The same encounter preserves party HP and taunt cooldown across the phase boundary.
Taunt only lasts the immediately following enemy phase and applies automatically to the same still-living target.
Actual killing normal attacks suppress taunt and new cooldown.
Core vulnerability applies to only the next player action after its heavy attack, before rest.
Damage floors after all modifiers; effective damage caps at pre-hit HP. Healing caps at missing HP.
Displayed HP is rounded to 2 decimals, calculation uses exact rational arithmetic.
Prescribed plans stop early when a phase dies; dead targets are omitted without advancing actions. This is not a search for optimal actions.

clear_first_correct_taunt.meaning: Clear both mechanics before wounding shell; save ready taunt for the ranged intent on both faces.

leave_healer_one_real_heal.meaning: Leave mechanic B alive through action 4: one actual shell heal. Clear it before the final shell hit.

waste_taunt_on_both_rests.meaning: Use warrior when ready during each rest, causing cooldown to prevent the immediately following ranged redirection.

miss_one_ranged_after_first_rest.meaning: Waste taunt on the first face rest only; one ranged hit reaches the mage. Reserve taunt correctly on face two.

no_taunt_clear_first.meaning: Counterfactual pressure comparison only, not an approved first-entry tutorial route. No skill-only opening; accepts legal ranged hits on the mage.

full_health_retained_then_two_heals.meaning: Underlevelled M3 boundary branch: full-health attempt on action 2 preserves charges, so B can restore 6 HP on both actions 4 and 6 before being killed.

kill_shell_before_winding.meaning: Kill shell on action 6 while B still has one winding charge. The scheduled winding idles without spending or changing to an attack; B is killed next.

notes: All newly filled role/passive/skill parameters are first-playtest candidates.
Chapter-one replay disables passive procs, items, fireball and DOT.

Entry16 revision: one generic proof on first entry, player-confirmed level-5 taunt learning and explanation before battle, one second generic proof on first whole-encounter victory. No stage-14/15 proof or separate taunt practice.
Tutorial persistence and confirmation are requirements, not implemented storage. No-taunt simulations are counterfactual pressure comparisons, not approved first-entry routes.
Scoring in the first-chapter replay includes damage and taunt protection only.
